proposals.name: Child Care Millage Renewal
proposals.description: ”Shall the County of Luce renew the levy a property tax of .5 Mill ($0.50 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation) as reduced by headlee (.4873 Mill) for a period of three (3) years beginning with the tax year, 2028, 2029, 2030, inclusive, to be used for the care and placement of neglected, abused and delinquent children in Luce County (Child Care Fund); the estimate of revenue the Luce County Child Care Fund will collect if the millage is approved and levied in 2028 is approximately $122,871?” If…
proposals.ballotLanguage: ”Shall the County of Luce renew the levy a property tax of .5 Mill ($0.50 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation) as reduced by headlee (.4873 Mill) for a period of three (3) years beginning with the tax year, 2028, 2029, 2030, inclusive, to be used for the care and placement of neglected, abused and delinquent children in Luce County (Child Care Fund); the estimate of revenue the Luce County Child Care Fund will collect if the millage is approved and levied in 2028 is approximately $122,871?” If approved this would be a renewal of a previously authorized millage.
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote continues the existing levy of 0.5 mills for 3 years — generally no increase over what you pay now.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote lets the current millage expire; the service it funds would need cuts or other revenue.
proposals.conservativeView: Renewals are the least disruptive way to keep a service funded, but every renewal is a chance to ask whether the service is delivering value. Watch for "renewal" proposals that quietly restore Headlee rollbacks — that is a tax increase.
proposals.progressiveView: Keeps an existing, voter-approved service funded at the same rate with no new tax.

proposals.name: Sheriff Department Millage Renewal
proposals.description: “Shall Luce County continue to levy 1 mill ($1.00 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation) as reduced by headlee to fund two sheriff’s deputies and their necessary equipment such that Luce County will continue to have full time patrols, estimated to provide $244,762 in the first year of the levy, for a period of three years beginning tax year 2028, 2029, 2030 inclusive?” If approved this would be a renewal of a previously approved authorized millage.”

proposals.name: Ambulance Millage Renewal
proposals.description: Shall the limitation on the amount of taxes which may be imposed on taxable property within the limits of Luce County be renewed at the rate of One Dollar Fifty Cents ($1.50) per thousand dollars ($1,000) (1.5 mills) of the taxable value on all taxable property within Luce County for another five (5) years, 2027 through 2032, inclusive, for the purpose of providing funds for operating, purchasing, equipping, maintaining, and making capital improvements for the Luce County Ambulance Service, and…
proposals.ballotLanguage: Shall the limitation on the amount of taxes which may be imposed on taxable property within the limits of Luce County be renewed at the rate of One Dollar Fifty Cents ($1.50) per thousand dollars ($1,000) (1.5 mills) of the taxable value on all taxable property within Luce County for another five (5) years, 2027 through 2032, inclusive, for the purpose of providing funds for operating, purchasing, equipping, maintaining, and making capital improvements for the Luce County Ambulance Service, and shall Luce County be authorized to renew the levy of such millage for these purposes? If approved and levied in its entirety, it is estimated that the 1.5 mills would raise $356,097.00 for Luce County when levied in 2027. Funds from this millage will be distributed to the Luce County Ambulance Service.
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote continues the existing levy of 1.5 mills for 2027–2032 — generally no increase over what you pay now.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote lets the current millage expire; the service it funds would need cuts or other revenue.

proposals.progressiveView: Keeps an existing, voter-approved service funded at the same rate with no new tax.
